recent_lines: Knees screaming. Heart rate spiked. Cadence collapsed. Garmin says "moderate effort.
Checked the weather four times. Still left in the wrong kit.
The climb looked shorter on Komoot.
Why do I always find my best legs on the way home?
Half-wheeling me since kilometre one and he calls it "just riding.
Nobody told me "quick spin" meant four hours and 1,800m of climbing.
The café stop was supposed to be optional.
The Strava segment ended 200m ago. I'm still sprinting.
Four bikes in the garage. One has seen tarmac this month.
My kit is perfectly colour-matched. My fitness is absolutely not.
Legs felt incredible. Right up until the first actual climb.
My Garmin has seen every kilometre. My wife has not.
Three water bottles packed. Forgot to fill any of them.
The group slows for the café. I'm still on a KOM attempt.
Why do I always pick the hilliest route when my legs are already cooked?
